definitions.explanation: The tenth day of any month.

{十日|とおか}⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{十日|とおか}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わらせて→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{十日|とおか}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{十日|とおか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空|あ}いています→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Are you free on the 10th of next month?

⟦あと→後：09580_ato⟧{十日|とおか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}する→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: It will be completed in ten days.

examples.japanese: {十日|とおか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: I got to see them for the first time in ten days.

notes:
{十日|とおか} uses native Japanese counting and has two meanings: the 10th day of the month, and a duration of ten days.

DAYS OF THE MONTH (1-10):
The first ten days use special native Japanese readings:
- ⟦{一日|ついたち}→一日：10993_tsuitachi⟧ (1st)
- ⟦{二日|ふつか}→二日：02954_futsuka⟧ (2nd)
- ⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧ (3rd)
- ⟦{四日|よっか}→四日：02985_yokka⟧ (4th)
- ⟦{五日|いつか}→いつか：01809_itsuka⟧ (5th)
- ⟦{六日|むいか}→六日：02973_muika⟧ (6th)
- ⟦{七日|なのか}→七日：02927_nanoka⟧ (7th)
- ⟦{八日|ようか}→八日：02983_youka⟧ (8th)
- ⟦{九日|ここのか}→九日：02901_kokonoka⟧ (9th)
- {十日|とおか} (10th)

After the 10th, most days use Sino-Japanese numbers + ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧ (e.g., ⟦{十一日|じゅういちにち}→十一日：30352_juuichinichi⟧).

DURATION USAGE:
- {十日|とおか}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧: a ten-day period
- {十日|とおか}⟦ぶり→ぶり：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: for the first time in ten days
- {十日|とおか}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: it takes about ten days
